titles.romaji: Goulart Knights: Evoked the Beginning Black
titles.english: Goulart Knights: Evoked the Beginning Black
titles.native: グラール騎士団 Evoked the Beginning Black

description: Unidentified creatures "Archon" suddenly appear and bring the human beings to a crisis of extinction. A special corps "Goulart Knights" is formed to counter attack Archon. The knights have supernatural power to generate "Holy Grail" from their spirits and battle against Archon.
